name: ticketfr
description: TicketFr — Portal de venta de entradas (Caso Integrador, Ingeniería de Software).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend && node Backend/scripts/crear-env.mjs && npm run db:reset --prefix Backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix Backend && npm run typecheck --prefix Frontend
